headline: Honor’s Magic 9 Pro Max has a big camera and a bigger battery
summary: Honor launched its new Magic 9 Pro Max flagship phone in China. It features a significant design revamp and a capable camera system. The device also boasts a colossal battery, building on Honor's Arri collaboration.

headline: Out of the Park Baseball lets me enjoy baseball even when the Mets suck
summary: The reviewer has spent over 2,300 hours playing Out of the Park Baseball (OOTP). OOTP is praised as a deep, cozy baseball simulation game. It offers enjoyment even when real-life teams like the Mets are performing poorly.

headline: Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
summary: Thoughtful Things has launched Engram, an AI-powered sampler and groovebox. Engram uses AI to mangle incoming audio and generate new sounds. It's designed as an experimental instrument, not a simple song-creation device.

headline: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
summary: OpenAI agents reportedly scanned a UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) website over 16,000 times. The activity occurred between April and June, targeting its statistics site. Security researchers highlighted this as a concerning example of AI misuse.

headline: Fortnite Five Nights at Freddy's Announcement is Now the Game's Most Liked Reveal Ever, Beating the Avengers and Dragon Ball Z
summary: Fortnite's Five Nights at Freddy's crossover announcement is its most-liked social media post. It surpassed previous popular reveals like Avengers and Dragon Ball Z. The record highlights the immense anticipation for the new collaboration.

headline: 78-Year-Old Fortnite Streaming Grandmother Now Holds a World Record
summary: Cath Bowie, a 78-year-old grandmother, has achieved a world record. She now holds a record for streaming Fortnite. This achievement showcases the game's broad appeal across different age groups.

headline: Where to Preorder Magic: The Gathering’s Reality Fracture Expansion (Out This Week!)
summary: Magic: The Gathering's new Reality Fracture expansion is launching this week. The article provides a guide on where to preorder various products. Fans can find Play Boosters, Commander precons, and Bundles available.

headline: The Mummy 4 Set Photos Reveal Rachel Weisz as Evelyn O'Connell, Suggest Time Period
summary: Set photos confirm Rachel Weisz will reprise her role as Evelyn O'Connell. She will appear in the upcoming 'The Mummy 4' movie. The images also provide clues about the film's potential time period.

headline: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe and the five men arrested
summary: Five men have been arrested near RAF Fairford in a counter-terror probe. Police are leading an investigation into a major incident close to the airbase. Details about the ongoing counter-terrorism investigation are emerging.

headline: UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says
summary: Diesel prices in the UK have reached an all-time high, according to the RAC. The surge is attributed to the US-Israel war with Iran. Geopolitical tensions are significantly impacting global fuel costs.

headline: Thousands of illegal ghost plates on cars revealed by new cameras
summary: New camera technology has uncovered thousands of illegal 'ghost plates' on cars. These illicit registration plates are reportedly easy to obtain. The BBC warns that they pose a significant risk to public safety.

headline: Police block Protestant Orange Order from controversial parade route
summary: Police blocked the Protestant Orange Order from a controversial parade route. Protesters had gathered on the mainly-nationalist Garvaghy Road. The blockage prevented the permitted Sunday morning parade from proceeding.
